newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan PM says schools must teach Koran.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan PM says schools must teach Koran.

text.p: Pakistan's new Prime Minister Nawaz Sharif on Monday made studying the Koran a compulsory subject for Moslem pupils, the official APP news agency said.
It said Sharif had ordered the Ministry of Education to place studies of the Islamic holy book on the curriculum for pupils in grades six to 10, who are aged about 11 to 15.
Sharif, whose Pakistan Muslim League party won a landslide victory in February 3 elections, promised before the polls to enforce the teaching of the Koran in schools.
